Alger, 29 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, October 29, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — TECNO Algeria announces the availability of its new POVA Curve 2 5G smartphone, highlighting its battery life and performance.
La marque TECNO Algérie vient de lancer: The TECNO Algeria brand has just officially launched the POVA Curve 2 5G on the Algerian market. This new model stands out with its massive 8000 mAh battery, promising up to three days of use without recharging. It also benefits from 45W fast charging technology to minimize waiting times. The device features a curved AMOLED screen with a 144Hz refresh rate, offering a smooth visual experience. Under the hood, the POVA Curve 2 5G is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7100 processor, ensuring 5G connectivity and enhanced performance for applications and multitasking.
